_flow_.description: Generative execution flow for transforming the preserved BSD stack into BSD-based Field observations and academically normalized Field identities.

mutation.description: Controls the degree of observational mutation applied during Field generation by regulating how evenly or selectively reasoning influence is distributed across observers.

low.example: Maintain broadly stable observer influence with only minor differentiation when evidence or disciplinary context warrants it.
low.explanation: Introduces limited mutation while keeping the generation close to a balanced multi-observer baseline.

even.example: Maintain approximately equal reasoning influence across all declared observers.
even.explanation: Provides the neutral baseline for BSD-to-Field observation without intentionally privileging any observer.

high.example: Allow substantially differentiated observer influence according to the observed BSD, available evidence, and disciplinary context.
high.explanation: Introduces stronger mutation to expose alternative Field expressions and observer-dependent differences.

constraint.observer_coverage: All observers declared in _field_contract_.observers must remain active in every mutation mode.
constraint.weight_semantics: Observer weights represent reasoning influence allocated during the current generation run. They do not represent truth probability, confidence, evidence strength, or academic authority.
constraint.runtime_record: The actual observer weights determined during generation must be recorded in _generation_.mutation.observer_weights.

process.instruction: Load and preserve the complete BSD stack defined in _bsd_stack_. Do not modify BSD identities, names, order, or boundaries.

Read mutation.control.current_setting and dynamically determine the reasoning influence of observers a through f according to the selected mutation mode. Keep every declared observer active and record the actual observer weights used during this generation run.

Observe every BSD independently through every observer defined in _field_contract_.observers. Retrieve observer-appropriate evidence and preserve differences in terminology, granularity, overlap, and interpretation.

Generate bsd_based_fields_set as the direct BSD-based observation projection. Preserve Field duplication across BSDs, overlapping ownership, ambiguity, granularity differences, and apparent classification paradoxes without prematurely resolving them.

Compare observed Field expressions across the complete BSD stack and normalize academically defensible Field identities according to _field_contract_. Require authoritative provenance for every adopted canonical Field identity and semantic definition, and provide an explicit normalization rationale.

Generate academic_based_fields_set as a deduplicated one-dimensional collection of normalized academic Field identities. Do not organize Fields by BSD ownership and do not infer hierarchical, parent-child, nested, or other academic topology at this stage.

Verify that every normalized Field conforms to _field_contract_.field_schema, that its canonical identity, definition, and normalization rationale are supported by traceable provenance, and that model prior knowledge has not been represented as provenance.
Materialize the complete generation result into bsd2field_generated.json without modifying the source specification, preserved BSD basement, or Field contract.
